page_title: TOT 3-1 CRY | Tottenham Hotspur v Crystal Palace 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
90+3' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. Heung-Min Son will be replaced by Dane Scarlett (Tottenham).
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' It will be a substitution. Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) is ready to enter the pitch as Yves Bissouma walks off.
88' 3 - 1 Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
87' The attendance for today's match is 61339.
83' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) replacing James Maddison.
82' Substitution. Timo Werner did his best and is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).

80' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) makes it 2:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from James Maddison and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Sam Johnstone was helpless.
77' 1 - 1 Goal! Timo Werner (Tottenham) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Brennan Johnson. The score is 1:1.
75' John Brooks has issued a yellow card to Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace).
75' Close! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
74' James Maddison (Tottenham) whips in a cross from the corner, but Sam Johnstone is well positioned and punches the ball away.
72' Flag up against Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Jordan Ayew cannot continue after picking up an injury.
71' Substitution. Adam Wharton makes his way off the pitch and Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) comes on as his replacement.
70' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
67' A dangerous looking corner kick from James Maddison (Tottenham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
66' Oliver Glasner has decided to make a change. Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) replaces Eberechi Eze.
66' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is replacing Rodrigo Bentancur.
63' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

62' Timo Werner (Tottenham) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Sam Johnstone is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
62' A corner kick by Tottenham is thwarted by the well prepared Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace).
59' 0 - 1 Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a brilliant free kick and curls the ball inside the right post to give the goalkeeper no chance!
58' The foul by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by John Brooks.
55' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham.
53' Timo Werner (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Now Tottenham have a corner.
51' James Maddison (Tottenham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
50' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but John Brooks ignores the protests.
49' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
49' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Tottenham force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
45+1' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is flagged for offside.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Timo Werner (Tottenham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
42' The resulting corner, taken by Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace), comes to nothing.
42' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
40' James Maddison (Tottenham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
40' Timo Werner (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
39' The percentage of ball possession is – 82:18.
37' The foul by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) was seen by John Brooks who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' John Brooks blows the whistle, Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul.
35' James Maddison (Tottenham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
35' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is adjudged offside.
28' John Brooks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) brought his opponent down.
26' James Maddison (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

26' James Maddison (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. The linesman points to the corner flag, Tottenham are going to take it.
24' Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
23' Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
21' Flag goes up against Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' Lovely run from Timo Werner (Tottenham). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
18' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
17' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Heung-Min Son, but Sam Johnstone displays great awareness to stop him.
15' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement.

13' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
13' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
12' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) brings his opponent down. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace have a free kick.
10' Looks like Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
8' James Maddison (Tottenham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
6' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
5' Timo Werner (Tottenham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.

The players are on the pitch and Tottenham will have the kick-off.
